description: Waterfall Chart explains contribution analysis step by step. It starts from a baseline, applies increases and decreases, and ends at a final total so users can see exactly what drove the net result. Waterfall Chart is useful for variance analysis, P&L walkdowns, budget versus actual stories, and period-over-period decomposition. It turns a single number into a clear narrative and identifies the biggest drivers quickly. ### Key features - Supports different total strategies: total at every category, none, or **measure-name contains "total"** mode. - Optional **cumulative values** mode for running-total style storytelling. - Toggle **labels**, **X axis**, **Y axis**, and **growth percentages** independently. - Control spacing and focus with **X/Y axis padding** and configurable **Y-min truncation (%)**. - Separate color controls for **positive**, **negative**, and **total** bars plus axis styling. - Supports dedicated tooltip templates for **bars** and **totals**. **Stay up to date!** Contact: support@appsforpowerbi.com Website: https://appsforpowerbi.infotopics.com/
